{{Short description|Russian mathematician}}
'''Dmitrii Matveyevich Sintsov''' ({{Langx|ru|Дмитрий Матвеевич Синцов}}; 20 November 1867, [[Kirov, Kirov Oblast|Vyatka]] – 28 January 1946, [[Kharkiv]]) was a Russian [[mathematician]] known for his work in the theory of [[conic section]]s and [[nonholonomic system|non-holonomic geometry]]. 

He took a leading role in the development of mathematics at the [[National University of Kharkiv|University of Kharkiv]], serving as chairman of the [[Kharkiv Mathematical Society]] for forty years, from 1906 until his death at the age of 78.
